_comment: Curated Maven groupId:artifactId -> Java import-package prefix overrides for the famous groupId-doesn't-match-package cases. Each value is a single package prefix; multi-package artifacts list the most common top-level prefix (sub-modules covered by prefix-matching). Sources are the artifact's actual META-INF/MANIFEST.MF / pom.xml declared packages; when in doubt verify with `jar tf <artifact>.jar | head`. Loaded by packages/sca/reachability/maven.py; keeping the data out of the code keeps source diffs clean as the list grows (cf. python_module_map.json).
